slides.summary: This slide outlines Brex's highly attractive unit economics across different funding stages from Seed to Series D. It details metrics including monthly card spend, annual revenue, annual gross profit, and expected LTV with churn alongside reference customers.
key_points: At Seed stage, monthly card spend is $6,500, annual revenue is $1,800, annual gross profit is $1,400, expected LTV with churn is $270,000, and the reference customer is Blockscore.
At Series A, monthly card spend is $50,000, annual revenue is $14,000, annual gross profit is $11,000, expected LTV with churn is $580,000, and the reference customer is Threads.
At Series B, monthly card spend is $250,000, annual revenue is $70,000, annual gross profit is $60,000, expected LTV with churn is $900,000, and the reference customer is Human Longevity.
At Series C, monthly card spend is $750,000, annual revenue is $210,000, annual gross profit is $145,000, expected LTV with churn is $1,300,000, and the reference customer is Lending Home.
At Series D, monthly card spend is $1,500,000, annual revenue is $425,000, annual gross profit is $290,000, expected LTV with churn is $1,400,000, and the reference customer is SoFi.
